label: late-episode GO after a rewarded trial, agent choosing a2 with moderate confidence
explanation: Sparse feature (0.16% of steps), fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), only late in the episode (none before trial 60, rate rising through trials 70-99), and almost entirely when the model chooses a2 (99% of mass), mostly with a moderate a2 logit (choice in [-8.9,-4.4], 82% of mass) and a low value estimate. Never fires at D1/D2 or after an unrewarded trial. It is enriched 7x on switch trials. The strongest activations are switches from a1 to a2 after a rare-rewarded a1 to S2 trial, which is the model-based switch. The switch-only predicate (prev_action==1 & a2 & rewarded & late) reached dev F1 0.41 but covers only 41% of mass. The recorded broader predicate has dev F1 0.27 and mass recall 0.82: precision is low (0.17) because many late rewarded a2 choices do not activate it. Uses only observed inputs plus the model's own policy logit, no future variables.
